definitions.Gamma: oint |H|^2 dA / |I|^2 per surface, unit incoming current at the port (surface_Gamma; dimensionless: H per ampere is in 1/m)
definitions.Q_loss: omega L / R_loss, L = -Im Z / omega: the reactance's Q, the key shared with 2D and MQS (2 pi f L_p / R_eff there); beyond MQS it is not a resonator Q and tends to 0 at a self-resonance
definitions.Q_loss_tuned: the headline Q: omega L_eff / R_loss, L_eff = L + (omega / 2) dL/domega from the exact dZ/domega: the Q of the readout resonance when an ideal capacitor tunes the port to f (= 2 omega W_m / P_loss for a closed lossless structure; L > 0 only)
definitions.Q_total: omega L / (R_loss + max(Re Z, 0)): with radiation, bulk and boundary losses (Q_total_tuned with L_eff); withheld where Re Z / |X| is below 100 times the solve's true relative residual
definitions.R_eff_ohm: R_s(f) Gamma (Gamma_magnetoresistance with a magnetoresistance model)
definitions.R_loss_matrix_ohm: multiport: sum_b R_s,b oint H_j^* . H_k dA (Hermitian): the dissipated power 1/2 I^dagger R I of any combination of port currents. It equals the (symmetric) impedance perturbation only for in-phase port fields (closed, lossless); with radiation or bulk loss do not add it to Z
definitions.R_loss_ohm: sum of R_eff over the surfaces with rf data: 2 P_loss / |I|^2, the power the conductor surfaces dissipate (to first order the series resistance they add to Re Z)
definitions.R_loss_over_abs_X: R_loss / |Im Z|: the perturbation parameter; the neglected order is about its square
definitions.T_over_Q_K: sum over the rf surfaces of T_b R_eff,b / (omega L) (T_over_Q_tuned_K: with L_eff); radiation and bulk loss are not in it, as their temperatures are not known

summary.engine: 3D full wave: perturbative surface loss of the perfectly conducting structure's port fields, H = curl E / (i omega mu) on the field side, over the faces of pickup.losses
summary.scope: conductor and superconductor regions meshed as volumes; PEC boundary groups (mesh.remove_pec holes, imported PEC groups) and a closed outer sphere carry no loss here. Re Z keeps the bulk, Robin and PML losses of the solve itself; R_loss adds the conductor surfaces, which those do not contain

solver_path.strumpack: STRUMPACK real sparse LU reused across RHS with GMRES refinement
solver_path.tree_cotree: tree-cotree gauged STRUMPACK LU (E = S_c e + G_c phi, K G = 0 exact), Woodbury loads, iterative refinement on the transformed residual (normwise, extended residual); charge projection 2; gate on the split-form original-space residual
